topic_label: Commitment to integrity and ethical values
control_description: Code of conduct; sanctions under POL-01 4.14; annual acknowledgment
evidence: Code of conduct; acknowledgment report (98%); sanctions log

control_description: Board audit committee receives quarterly cyber risk reports and the annual Qualified Individual report
evidence: Audit committee minutes 2025-12, 2026-03, 2026-06, 2026-09; 2025 Qualified Individual report

control_description: Qualified Individual, PCI DSS charter, system owners, and reporting lines defined in POL-01
evidence: POL-01; designation letter; PCI DSS charter

control_description: Hiring standards, background checks, and role training; security team of 9
evidence: HR records; training records; staffing plan
gap: Integrated Payments developers not trained on secure coding; security capacity short for two clouds (R-047)
remediation: Train Integrated Payments developers; hire 2 cloud security engineers

control_description: Control owners named in the SSP and the PCI DSS responsibility matrix; quarterly reviews signed by the COO
Inventory, data-flow diagrams, and PCI DSS scope document support control operation
gap: Scope and inventory do not include Cloud B or the new interconnect (POAM-009)
remediation: Combined scope, inventory, and diagrams

topic_label: Internal communication of objectives and responsibilities
control_description: Policies published on the intranet and covered in training; incident reporting channel
evidence: Intranet; training content; interviews (15 of 15 staff knew how to report)

control_description: Merchant and ISV agreements, integration guides, status page, AOC and responsibility matrix on request
gap: No responsibility matrix for ISVs; no security schedule for the 20 largest ISVs (POAM-025)
remediation: Publish the ISV matrix; add security schedules at renewal

topic_label: Objectives specified to enable risk identification
control_description: Objectives and risk appetite statements approved by the CEO
Written risk assessment per SP 800-30 (52 risks), annual and after significant change
Fraud risk considered: merchant fraud, funding account change scams, insider card harvesting, funding file tampering
gap: Funding account change controls and file signing not yet on all channels (POAM-005, POAM-020)
remediation: Extend step-up and call-back to Integrated Payments; sign funding files

control_description: Significant changes (acquisitions, migrations, interconnects) identified and assessed
gap: The acquisition and the 2026-04-18 interconnect change were not assessed for scope or control impact (POAM-009)
remediation: Organizational change review; scope confirmation after significant change

control_description: Independent annual assessment (co-sourced internal audit), QSA ROC, penetration tests
POA&M with owners and dates, reviewed monthly and reported to the audit committee

topic_label: Control activities selected to mitigate risk
control_description: Controls selected from the High baseline and PCI DSS to address P01 risks
General IT controls over infrastructure, access, change, and operations
gap: Cloud B general IT controls weaker than the core platform (access, change, monitoring)
remediation: Interim Cloud B controls; migration in 2027

topic_label: Control activities deployed through policies and procedures
control_description: Policies POL-01 to POL-05 and standards STD-01 to STD-10
gap: 8 of 10 standards are in draft or need updates (P06)
remediation: Issue standards per the P06 schedule

topic_label: Logical access security software, infrastructure, architecture
control_description: Identity provider, PAM, encryption, and network controls protect information assets
gap: Cloud B consoles outside PAM; long-lived keys; Cloud B key policies without dual control (POAM-002, POAM-006, POAM-013)
remediation: PAM, federation, and key role for Cloud B

control_description: HR-driven provisioning with manager and system owner approval
gap: Cloud B accounts outside the HR feed (POAM-004)
remediation: Federate Cloud B; remove IAM users

control_description: Role-based access, least privilege, six-month reviews, transfer handling
gap: Standing Cloud B administrator roles; no service account reviews; transfers keep prior roles (POAM-002, POAM-004)
remediation: Just-in-time elevation everywhere; service account reviews; transfer workflow

control_description: Cage access control with badges, biometrics, cameras, and escorts; cloud and colocation facilities inherited
gap: Escort not recorded for 2 of 30 sampled visits (POAM-018)
remediation: Escort sign-off on every visit ticket

control_description: Media destruction under certificate; retention schedule
control_owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
gap: PAN kept 7 years in the settlement archive; no onboarding file disposal schedule (POAM-022)
remediation: 18-month archive limit; disposal schedule

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Web application firewalls, CDN protection, segmentation, MFA for remote and portal access
gap: Integrated Payments portal users without MFA; management network route into settlement (POAM-005, POAM-008)
remediation: Portal MFA; remove the route; retest segmentation

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: TLS 1.2 or higher; private links to networks and banks; funding files encrypted in transit

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR, runtime protection, payment page script integrity, and file integrity monitoring
gap: No script integrity or tamper-detection on the hosted payment fields; unsupported settlement operating system (POAM-001, POAM-015)
remediation: Script controls on the hosted payment fields; replace unsupported servers

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Vulnerability scanning, configuration baselines, and drift monitoring
gap: Critical patches late on cage servers; Cloud B scans unauthenticated; no Cloud B baseline (POAM-007, POAM-014)
remediation: Monthly maintenance windows; authenticated scans; baselines

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: 24x7 MSSP monitoring of the SIEM, IDS, and egress analytics
gap: Cloud B not monitored (POAM-003)
remediation: Onboard Cloud B to the SIEM and MSSP

control_description: Security events triaged and escalated by the MSSP and the security team
gap: Root cause missing for 2 of 10 sampled incidents (POAM-017)
remediation: Root cause required to close

control_description: Incident response policy and two runbooks with a notification matrix
gap: Not yet tested or distributed to Integrated Payments; Bank B contacts missing (POAM-017)
remediation: Executive tabletop 2026-11-04; distribute; record contacts

control_description: Recovery runbooks and tests for authorization and settlement
gap: Tests missed their RTOs; gateway never tested (POAM-011)
remediation: Automated failover; settlement DR test with both banks

control_description: Change control with two approvals and signed builds on the core platform
gap: Integrated Payments self-approved changes (POAM-010)
remediation: Branch protection; change advisory board coverage

control_description: BIA (P05), cyber insurance, and recovery strategies
gap: Recovery strategies not proven (see CC7.5)
remediation: As CC7.5

topic_label: Vendor and business partner risk management
control_description: Third-party program with tiers, AOC and SOC 2 reviews, and responsibility matrices
gap: 7 of 34 service providers lack an AOC or matrix; acquired vendors not tiered (POAM-016)
remediation: Collect AOCs and matrices; tier acquired vendors

control_description: Capacity monitoring for authorization (peak 260 per second, headroom tested to 600) and settlement batch windows
Environmental protections inherited from cloud and colocation providers; backups with write-once retention
evidence: Provider AOCs; backup reports (30 of 30 days)
gap: Cloud B snapshots in the same region only (POAM-011)
remediation: Cross-region copy for the gateway

control_description: Recovery plan testing
gap: Recovery tests missed their RTOs; no test with the sponsor banks (POAM-011)
remediation: Settlement DR test with both banks; automated failover tests

topic_label: Identification and maintenance of confidential information
control_description: Data classification (POL-04) and PAN discovery on non-CDE stores
gap: Card verification codes in call recordings; PAN in historical tickets (POAM-012)
remediation: Automatic recording pause; purge

control_description: Disposal of confidential information
control_owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
gap: Retention beyond need in the archive and onboarding files (POAM-022)
remediation: Retention limits and disposal schedule

control_description: Processing specifications for authorization, clearing, settlement, and funding documented and shared with the banks
control_owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations

control_description: Input validation on APIs and file formats; duplicate detection
Daily three-way reconciliation of network settlement, bank accounts, and merchant funding; breaks worked within 1 business day
control_owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
evidence: Reconciliation reports (30 of 30 days in July)

control_description: Outputs (clearing and funding files) validated against control totals and released under dual control
control_owner: Director of Settlement and Treasury Operations
gap: Funding files not digitally signed (POAM-020)
remediation: HSM signing with bank verification

control_description: Stored processing data protected and retained per policy; DR replication
gap: DR cage key replication stale, so stored settlement data may not be usable after failover (POAM-013)
remediation: Key ceremony at the DR cage
